summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests letrozole and abemaciclib, alone or with metformin or gedatolisib, in estrogen receptor positive (ER+) endometrial cancer. Abemaciclib is taken by mouth twice a day and letrozole is taken by mouth once a day; metformin is taken by mouth once a day in one arm, and gedatolisib is given into a vein on days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle in other arms. The record does not state the main outcome measure, and the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa letrozol y abemaciclib, solos o con metformina o gedatolisib, en cáncer de endometrio con receptor de estrógeno positivo (ER+). El abemaciclib se toma por boca dos veces al día y el letrozol se toma por boca una vez al día; la metformina se toma por boca una vez al día en un grupo, y el gedatolisib se administra en una vena los días 1, 8 y 15 de un ciclo de 28 días en otros grupos. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado, y el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Endometrial cancer that is recurrent or metastatic, or resistant to standard treatments, or with no standard treatment available
Tumor that is estrogen receptor positive, with at least 1 percent of cells positive
Disease that can be measured on scan or exam
Age 18 or older with performance status score of 0 or 1
Adequate blood counts and organ function
not_for: Prior CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment, except Cohort 7, which requires it
For Cohorts 6 and 7: type 1 diabetes, uncontrolled type 2 diabetes, or prior PI3K pathway inhibitor
